base.prompt: Create ONE full-body transparent battle-ready character image of CHANGWUYU. Reference 1 is EXACT CHARACTER IDENTITY (male mage); reference 2 is ONLY the economical painterly anime STYLE, never use reference 2's female identity, clothes, goggles or sword. Changwuyu: elegant slender MALE elf mage, pale skin, yellow/golden eyes, pointed ears, thin round metal eyeglasses, silver-gray long hair tied in a LOW bun behind head, two simple long straight sidelocks. A large BLACK wide-brim witch hat with a bent pointed tip and PURPLE underside. Black HIGH-COLLAR long robe/cape down to ankles, PURPLE lining, minimal GOLD edging, black gloves and black ankle/military boots. White feather plus blue sapphire in small gold brooch on LEFT chest (not on hat). NO STAFF, no wand, no sword. Battle body and eyes face SCREEN RIGHT in a gentle three-quarter SIDE view, calm male face, right gloved hand near the eyeglass bridge, left gloved hand relaxed near waist, feet modestly apart and stable, no dramatic lunge. Keep only a SMALL solid black ink-cloud companion just behind the shoulder on screen-left, compact and clearly readable. NO fire orb, NO fireball or flame, NO casting glow or magical projectile. Match exact clothing construction/hat/face from reference 1 while greatly simplifying detail: broad angular opaque color blocks, economical hand-painted anime edges, hard-edged light and shadow planes, only 3-5 large robe fold masses, simple straight hair shapes, no dense wrinkles, fine trim patterns or photorealistic textures. Same level of simplification as Wu battle sprite. Full body hat tip, boots and compact cloud entirely in the landscape 1536x1024 canvas, generous transparent padding 8% on all sides, the whole group centered; reserve right-side room for future casting. GENUINELY transparent RGBA background; no white backdrop, ground, shadow, smoke backdrop, glow halo, text, watermarks or grid. The purple lining/gold trim and white feather-blue gem are the only clothing accent colors. This image will be the immutable FIRST FRAME of idle, attack, hurt and death.
